human.name: Human
human.desc: +1 to every attribute, +5 max HP. Adaptable, unremarkable, proud of both.

elf.name: Elf
elf.desc: +2 DEX, +1 INT, -2 CON. Graceful, fragile, insufferable about it.

dwarf.name: Dwarf
dwarf.desc: +2 CON, +2 STR, -2 DEX. Built like a filing cabinet.

hobgoblin.name: Hobgoblin
hobgoblin.desc: +2 DEX; crits on 17-20 instead of just 20. -1 AC. Fights dirty, bruises easily.

bog_troll.name: Bog Troll
bog_troll.desc: +2 STR, +2 CON, -2 INT, -2 CHA. Regenerates twice as fast. The System stops calling you by name.

houseplant.name: Sentient Houseplant
houseplant.desc: +2 CON, -2 DEX. Bark: every hit on you does 1 less damage. Heals while standing still; safe rooms heal you fully on arrival. Can't wear armour.
